Printed edition: Memoirs of General Lafayette: With an Account of His Visit to America, and ..., E.G. House, 1824, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/memoirsgenerall01knapgoog. The scan does not show the credit of Samuel Lorenzo Knapp, Marie Joseph Paul Yves Roch Gilbert Du Motier Lafayette, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
